ios.name: Loop
ios.subtitle: Gift card cashback wallet
ios.promotionalText: Buy gift cards from big-name retailers at face value and earn cashback on every one. Pay from a wallet you control and save what's left to earn yield.
ios.whatsNew: Welcome to Loop. Buy gift cards at face value, earn cashback, and keep your balance in a passkey-secured wallet.
ios.description:
Loop is a cashback and savings wallet for gift cards.

Buy gift cards from big-name retailers in the US, UK, Europe and Canada. Every card is sold at face value and earns cashback. Pay from your own wallet in USDC, EURC, GBPLOOP or XLM, and see your balance and what you have earned on the home screen.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Shop gift cards and see the cashback rate on each one before you buy.
- Pay from your wallet and get your card in the app: barcode, card number, PIN and redeem link.
- Keep your balances in USDC, EURC, GBPLOOP and XLM.
- Put money into savings that earn yield, and withdraw when you want.
- Follow every order and every cashback payment in one place.

A WALLET THE USER OWNS
Your wallet is secured by a passkey and a key held on your phone. Approving a payment takes Face ID or your fingerprint. There is no seed phrase to write down.

The wallet is controlled by the user's passkey and device. Loop can recover a wallet only after 90 days in which the owner has not approved any transaction, and the owner can cancel that recovery during a 7-day window.

SIGN IN
Sign in with your email address and a one-time code. Your wallet opens on the phone where you created it.

WHAT YOU NEED
- A phone with Face ID, Touch ID or a fingerprint set up.
- A passkey provider: iCloud Keychain on iPhone, or Google Password Manager on Android.

Privacy policy: https://loopfinance.io/privacy
Terms of service: https://loopfinance.io/terms
Support: support@loopfinance.io

review.demoAccountNote: Sign in with the submission's reviewer address, reviewer+<n>@<reviewer mailbox>, where <n> is the submission number. The emailed code arrives in the reviewer mailbox webmail. That account has never had a wallet.
review.notes:
Sign in with the reviewer address in the demo account field. Enter the emailed code, then create the wallet on first launch.

The review device needs a passcode and enrolled biometrics. iPhone: Face ID or Touch ID enrolled, signed in to iCloud with iCloud Keychain on. Android: fingerprint enrolled, Google account with Google Password Manager on.

Custody: The wallet is controlled by the user's passkey and device. Loop can recover a wallet only after 90 days in which the owner has not approved any transaction, and the owner can cancel that recovery during a 7-day window.

Funding: once the build shows as in review, we send 10 USDC to this reviewer account's wallet address. To request the top-up, write to support@loopfinance.io.

Screen recording of the full flow (sign in, create wallet, buy a gift card, order detail, savings deposit): <recording link>.

Tracking: none. No advertising. No data sold. Encryption: standard TLS only.
